nodes.name: game_object.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements GameObject update, destructor cleanup, trigger callbacks, collision-ignore lists, transform sync, reparenting, and visual/collider draw.

nodes.name: project_manager.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements project create/open/save, recent-list tracking, engine-asset copy, gravity/audio bus activation, and the Windows folder picker.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses Win32 IFileDialog plus nlohmann::json project files; scaffolds a content .sln and build scripts for new projects.

nodes.name: collider.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements box, sphere, capsule, cylinder, and mesh colliders: world poses, contact generation, resolution, ray tests, and debug wireframes.
nodes.languageNotes: Per-shape CheckCollision/ResolveCollision overrides plus shared ResolveContact that writes velocity, friction, and contact flashes.

nodes.name: IsInsideUpdate
nodes.summary: True while any GameObject::Update is on the call stack.

nodes.name: Update
nodes.summary: Ticks 3D emitters, listener tracking, finished-instance sweep, and debug draw.

nodes.name: Update_IsParallelSafe
nodes.summary: Reports whether all attached scripts allow parallel Update.

nodes.name: ~GameObject
nodes.summary: Notifies audio and physics, detaches components, and deletes host-owned colliders.

nodes.name: OnTriggerEnter
nodes.summary: Forwards trigger-enter to the object's Script component.

nodes.name: OnTriggerExit
nodes.summary: Forwards trigger-exit to the object's Script component.

nodes.summary: Stops ignoring a specific GameObject pair.

nodes.name: ClearIgnoreCollisionObjects
nodes.summary: Clears all per-object collision ignores.

nodes.name: IgnoresCollisionWith
nodes.summary: True if tags or object-ignore lists skip this pair.
